## Claim amendment · file surface · 2026-11-15T16:28Z

Claim 6897589827's file surface widens by `packages/qa/scenarios/src/export/transcript.ts` (only the `StepRef` that `buildTranscript` builds, so it carries the result's repeat) and one pin under `packages/qa/scenarios/test/export/`.

Why: the gallery exporter joins a run record to its recording by step key, building the key from question and persona alone (seat read `origin/main` `bc6b7ffd`, `buildTranscript`). Once repeats 2..N carry a key suffix, an N>1 record would show repeat 1's reply under every repeat's grade, or refuse the whole export when grades differ. This PR is what makes that join wrong, so it fixes it in the same stroke.

Also accepted: the repeat count rides on `CardRun` as an optional `askRepeats`, not inside `counts`, because `export/record.ts` parses `counts` as a strict object and an N>1 record would stop the export. N=1 records stay byte-identical.

## Landed · 2026-11-15T19:21Z

PR #34047 merged as `f81e4b6c` (ACCEPT 6898640512; contract review PASS 6898343573). `--ask-repeats N` (default 1) asks each (question, persona) turn N times on the same booted app, each ask a fresh agent session graded on its own; operations run once. The record keeps every ask (`QuestionResult.repeat`, `CardRun.askRepeats`), Run-问数 counts passes over every asked turn, and a k/N table per Run half appears only when N > 1. Guardrails, `Run · model`, `Ask cost` and `Ask time` count each ask. The first ask keeps today's replay key and asks 2..N add `/repeat-N`, so existing recordings replay; under `recorded:` the flag sets how many recorded asks are read and an N the recording lacks is refused before any card runs. The gallery exporter joins each ask to its own reply (claim amendment 6897633587). With N = 1 the record, scorecard and export are unchanged. `pm:dispatched` dropped; card thread closing. Queue ① moves to #33742.
